component.name: Client VPN
component.summary: Unofficial client for AWS Client VPN with single sign-on

description.p: Connects to AWS Client VPN endpoints that use SAML federated authentication, using a hardened, open-source OpenVPN build and a small privileged service.
This is an unofficial client. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by Amazon Web Services. AWS and AWS Client VPN are trademarks of Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates.
